name: TurkTokenizer v5.11-v4.2 R1 Precommit v1
hypothesis: A length-normalized NULL-versus-head categorical decision will improve source-token calibration, especially OBJECT, without changing conditional head capacity or CASE_GOVERNOR.

single_delta.old_decision: independent source sigmoid multiplied by conditional head softmax
single_delta.new_decision: length-normalized categorical softmax over NULL plus valid heads
single_delta.null_logit_input: concatenated A1 relation_encoded and graph token states
single_delta.head_logits: unchanged A1 fused biaffine expert logits
single_delta.length_normalization: subtract log(valid_head_count) from every non-null head logit
single_delta.conditional_head_probability: softmax over unchanged non-null head logits
single_delta.loss: balanced focal joint soft cross-entropy with locked source gamma, positive share, uncertainty weights, and hard-negative penalty

explicitly_unchanged: A1 contextual morphology posterior and partial-marginal supervision
syntax, graph, morphology, dependency, and specialized experts
optimizer, learning rates, schedules, patience, and hard-negative mining
threshold grid and CALIB-only checkpoint selection

screen.survivor_action: Run seeds 51104, 51105, and 51106 with paired surface-group bootstrap intervals.
screen.drop_action: Close R1 before INTERNAL_VAL and perform error decomposition; do not tune on CALIB after the screen.
